name: chrome-alert-squeeze
brief: Close backlog rows .sir/backlog.md:35 and :36 by measurement. In the Pod-bar .chrome flex row, the fork-error alert has a zero flex basis but no min-width: 0, so when the Pod tabs alone fill or overflow the row it may still take its min-content width from the Pod bar; and the open-error and pods-error alerts are bare .listError paragraphs with the default 0 1 auto basis of their whole message, the mechanism that once collapsed the tab titles under the fork error. The fork-UI hand-run driver gains observations that fill the row with tabs and compare Pod-bar and tab-title widths with and without each alert, each with a control predicted to fire. CSS changes only where a measurement shows a squeeze, bounding the alert the way the fork error is bounded (zero basis, two-line clamp, title holding the whole message, text a direct text node, role=alert kept). Each closing row cites a measured pass in the driver report.
